entry.title: Project access is not object permission
entry.summary: Having access to a project, workspace, or tenant does not mean every nested action is allowed. Read on the folder is not delete on every child. Member of the org is not admin on every resource inside it. Authorize each request as subject + action + resource — including nested objects — instead of stopping at “they can see the parent.”

entry.summary: On November 30, 2022, Sam Altman tweeted some very exciting news; ChatGPT was here. Since then, AI has become a hot topic online. People often debate whether AI will be the doom of humanity or whether it will take our jobs. So I want to take the time to actually talk about the real problem with AI. The thing is, AI could doom humanity or take our jobs. But there’s a bigger issue; human intelligence. No one seems to talk about it. As AI rises, so does the decline of our own intelligence. The Problem Is Never Just "It Doesn't Implement the Interface"
Go's interface satisfaction is structural and compile-time, which sounds safe until you're debugging why a concrete type that clearly has all the right methods refuses to satisfy an interface in a different package—or worse, satisfies it silently and then behaves incorrectly at runtime because pointer receivers were embedded into a value type that gets copied across a serialization boundary.
